text: The synthetic v1 contract does not define safe retry behavior. Escalate ambiguous repeat requests for human review.
title: Synthetic Payments Contract v1

text: An investigation must retain the payment identifier and the identifiers of the related requests.
title: Synthetic Payments Contract v1

text: A human reviewer must approve the registration of an investigation case. Investigating a request does not authorize a new payment.
title: Synthetic Payments Contract v1

text: A repeated idempotency key with a different payload must be rejected. Preserve the original request identifier and escalate for investigation.
title: Synthetic Payments Contract v2

text: A repeated key with the same payload refers to the original request and must not create another payment.
title: Synthetic Payments Contract v2

text: Preserve the original request identifier when reporting an idempotency conflict. Include the identifiers of the related requests in the investigation case.
title: Synthetic Payments Contract v2

text: Compare the payload hashes of requests that share an idempotency key. A claim that the payload changed requires different observed payload hashes.
title: Synthetic Payments Contract v2

text: Consult the payment events before preparing an investigation recommendation. A contractual clause does not establish that a payment event occurred.
title: Synthetic Payments Contract v2

text: If the requested payment is not found, report insufficient operational evidence. Do not invent payment events or related requests.
title: Synthetic Payments Contract v2

text: A human reviewer must approve the exact case before registration. An investigation recommendation does not authorize a payment or a refund.
title: Synthetic Payments Contract v2

text: An approved procedural memory may guide an investigation. The current contract takes precedence over an incompatible memory, and a memory does not grant permissions.
title: Synthetic Payments Contract v2

text: Registering an investigation case does not approve a new procedural memory. A reusable lesson requires a separate human review of its content, contract version and source execution.
title: Synthetic Payments Contract v2
